description: Crawl a website from a start URL and return every page as Markdown or HTML. Follows links and sitemaps, fetches each page once, and handles JavaScript rendering, retries and proxies. Returns up to 500 pages in one response; if it runs out of time, returns the pages finished so far marked as partial. Each page costs credits (0.25 without a browser, 1 with JavaScript rendering, +4 with a proxy), so set maxPages and allowPatterns to keep the crawl small. Use map first to see what a crawl would visit and cost

allowPatterns.description: Only crawl URLs that match one of these patterns, e.g. "/docs/*"

denyPatterns.description: Skip URLs that match one of these patterns, e.g. "/tag/*" or "/login"

maxDepth.description: How many links away from the start URL to go

maxPages.description: The most pages to fetch. Defaults to 500, the maximum

proxyCountry.description: Country code (ISO alpha-2) to crawl through a premium proxy in, e.g. "de". Adds 4 credits per page

proxyMode.description: auto: use a premium proxy only for pages that block the crawler. true: always use one. Adds 4 credits per proxied page

renderJS.description: Render pages in headless Chrome. Set false for static sites (cheaper)

url.description: Where the crawl starts. Any public URL, or a sitemap URL to crawl every page in it

name: crawl
